records.name: Köderwart Empörlich
records.biography_en: Knows the catch is ready when it calls itself an independent response. His HyperNorm lure promises an outrage that anybody can discover for themselves. A dissonant card notices the line running back to his hand. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Reaktion wurde frei gewählt und sorgfältig angeködert.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows the catch is ready when it calls itself an independent response.

records.name: Ablenker Nebenbei
records.biography_en: Keeps every eye occupied while the important thing waits elsewhere. His three objects keep HyperNorm eyes busy while a difficult question changes rooms. A dissonant card watches the hands rather than the spectacle. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Aufmerksamkeit ist vollständig anderweitig gebunden.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps every eye occupied while the important thing waits elsewhere.

records.name: Entschuldigerin Fastaufrichtig
records.biography_en: Is deeply sorry that the audience has misunderstood her timing. Her HyperNorm mirror checks whether contrition looks convincing from the audience side. A dissonant card asks who the apology is meant to help. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Bedauern ist bereits für die Außenwirkung vorbereitet.

variant_notes.note_en: Is deeply sorry that the audience has misunderstood her timing.

records.name: Lampenwart Waranders
records.biography_en: Remembers the light having always been exactly this dim. His HyperNorm lamp grows dimmer whenever somebody remembers seeing more. A dissonant card quietly records the position of the valve. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Licht war laut zuständiger Erinnerung immer so.

variant_notes.note_en: Remembers the light having always been exactly this dim.

records.name: Mitläuferin Taktfest
records.biography_en: Finds the right direction by listening for the loudest agreement. Her HyperNorm drum supplies a direction before anyone asks where the procession is going. A dissonant card listens for those unable to keep the beat. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Richtung folgt dem derzeit lautesten Takt.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds the right direction by listening for the loudest agreement.

records.name: Schweiger Unnahbar
records.biography_en: Considers silence most effective when everybody can hear the effort. His HyperNorm silence makes every unanswered question sound like the questioner's fault. A dissonant card sits beside him without trying to earn a reply. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Antwort wird durch beharrliches Nichtvorliegen erteilt.

variant_notes.note_en: Considers silence most effective when everybody can hear the effort.
